cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I can't open the cupboard. Was the sofa this close yesterday? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's more room for yoga now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Did making that room involve moving the sofa?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, I moved it. I put the things you'll need somewhere easier.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. Would those be the mugs in your sock drawer, or has someone else improved the kitchen too?

mechanism: A confidently manages room layout while accommodating B yoga space and using polite follow-up questions to obtain admissions about successive rearrangements.
confusable: Unlike generic curiosity, A follows evidence toward who altered shared space; authority depends on preserving B valued use while continuing questions.
comparison: Physical cupboard access and relocated contents differ from a picnic calendar and changed invitations.
seedUse: Use canonical D40-b sofa/yoga/cupboard/mugs chain and S02-b accommodating a participant preference; preserve all protected exceptions unchanged.
